stem: Which among the following hormones, in a lactating mother, is responsible for the growth of breast tissue?
concept: In a lactating mother prolactin drives lobuloalveolar growth of breast tissue and milk synthesis, while oxytocin causes milk ejection. NOTE: estrogen (ductal growth) and progesterone (alveolar growth) also enlarge the breast, but the lactation-specific answer intended here is prolactin.
subject: Physiology
